모두 고른 것은?

ㄱ. The seller may, even after the date for delivery, remedy at his own expense any failure to perform his obligations, if he can do so without unreasonable delay and without causing the buyer unreasonable inconvenience or uncertainty of reimbursement by the seller of expenses advanced by the buyer. The buyer retains any right to claim damages under this Convention.

ㄴ. If the seller requests the buyer to indicate whether he will accept performance and the buyer does not respond within a reasonable time, the seller may perform within the time indicated in his request.

ㄷ. The buyer may not, during the period, exercise any remedy which is inconsistent with performance by the seller.

ㄹ. A notice by the seller that he will perform within a specified period of time is assumed to carry with it the request referred to in the previous paragraph, that the buyer make known his decision.
output.notes: 원본 그림과 뽑은 글자 모두 우측이 잘려 있어 문장 일부와 ③번 보기가 확인되지 않음. 보기는 ①②④⑤ 네 개만 보이며 ③은 누락. 각 영문 항목은 잘린 부분을 복원하지 않고 보이는 범위 안에서 옮김; '(C' 뒤 문구와 ㄱ~ㄹ 일부 문장은 원본 확인 불가. 발문 '유엔협약(C'의 괄호 내용도 확인 불가.
